subject: [PATCH 14/16] selftests/mm: zap whole PTE tables in the khugepaged race harness

2026-08-02.patch_summary: This patch modifies the khugepaged race harness in the selftests/mm directory to occasionally zap a whole PMD-aligned area instead of individual pages. This is done by introducing a new condition that allows zapping a full table every 64 iterations, which can trigger the empty-table reclaim mechanism and free tables from under parked collapses. The patch aims to improve the test's ability to detect certain types of races between khugepaged and other kernel components.
